reviews.comment: I don't think I've met a more passionate professor. He teaches with not only high levels of enthusiasm, but understanding as well. Especially for higher-level stuff where it can get complex, he tries to tell you the story of why certain things in math work the way they do instead of reading off a textbook. Wonderful person and professor all around!

C.J. Bott was absolutely amazing not only as a professor, but as a mentor. I had his class for my master's bootcamp, in which he went through all major undergrad concepts off the top of his head. He is incredibly smart and always willing to answer questions, no matter how simple or complex they are. He made sure everyone was caught up and engaged.

Had MATH 142 (Business Calc.) with him last semester (Fall 2024). Recently, he accepted an offer to teach at BYU. If any students there are reading this while registering for courses, you'd be in good hands if you learned under Professor Bott. Responsive to feedback, diplomatic, punctual, and never strict. He offers second chances on missed items!

As someone who struggles with calculus, having Bott as my professor was super helpful. Favorite professor I've had at A&M. There were many opportunities to get help outside of class. He would have many weekly in-person office hours and multiple zoom reviews before exams. You can tell he truly cares and wants student to succeed!!

I had already taken calculus so math 142 was an easy bootleg of what I already knew however, CJ was an amazing professor and you could tell that he truly wanted his students to succeed. He was very kind and made an effort to email his students reminding them of due dates and hosted zoom reviews for every exam multiple days in a row! Great guy!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Favorite professor so far at A&M. Genuinely cares about his students and has a good energy every day that makes you want to show up. Test are very fair if you study a bit and many grades are dropped at the end. Taking this class has been the best choice I have made yet at A&M. 100% recommend.

Probably the best Math prof here at tamu, I was a bit hesitant to take this course but he made the experience all not too bad, he drops lots of grades at the end and is super helpful and caring, overall great proff and guy!

He is an amazing teacher who genuinely wants you to succeed. The tests were fair and tested the material needed, nothing extra. he also tried to help out as much as he could with extra credit! 10/10 would take again.

The best math professor out there. I have never met someone so good at answering dumb questions and not making you feel dumb. He is enthusiastic and loves his job and seeing his students succeed. His tests are not easy but very fair, with no surprises or double negatives. He gives partial credit on free responses and is always available to help.

Awesome professor. Was extremely caring, and could tell he really liked his job. He was very personable. He taught a hard class, and did quite good at teaching it. There is something about his character that is very kind. He uses real world problems that make it easier to understand. Mr. Bott will go far in his career as a professor.  TAKE HIM!!!!
